artifact_inventory.description: Reproducible verification of disjointness, mismatch words, Parikh consistency, and per-N separation tables

limitations: Establishes strict countable presentability and Graph comparison failure for the stated path-swap family; no claim on word-problem decidability or general finite-presentability criteria.
provenance: Independent SCOPE audit of TARGET resolution; proofs re-verified and script rerun in audit sandbox
record_title: Strict countable presentability of the path-swap monoid <a,b,c | a^n b c^n = c^n b a^n, n>=2>
